import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
const systemCi = true;
const SD = '/run/systemd/system';
const booted = existsSync(SD) && process.env.NEVER === '1';
test('gate a', { skip: !systemCi && 'needs systemd' }, (t) => { t.plan(1); t.assert.ok(true); });
test('acceptance: b', { skip: !booted && 'needs a disposable Linux CI runner with systemd' }, () => {});
